mapper.select: SELECT C.CLUB_ID AS clubId, C.CLUB_NAME AS clubName, CM.CLUB_ROLE AS memberRole, CM.MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus FROM HM_CLUB C LEFT JOIN HM_CLUB_MEMBER CM ON CM.CLUB_ID = C.CLUB_ID AND CM.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} WHERE C.CLUB_ID = #{clubId} AND C.CLUB_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT C.CLUB_ID FROM HM_CLUB C WHERE C.CLUB_ID = #{clubId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql:
WHERE P.CLUB_ID = #{clubId} AND P.POST_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND P.POST_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL
AND P.TITLE LIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!'
AND P.CONTENT LIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!'
AND M.NICKNAME LIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!'
AND ( P.TITLE LIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR P.CONTENT LIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HM_CLUB_POST P LEFT JOIN HM_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.AUTHOR_MEMBER_ID

SELECT P.CLUB_POST_ID AS postId, P.TITLE AS title, CASE WHEN AUTHOR_CM.MEMBER_STATUS = 'LEFT' THEN '탈퇴한 회원' WHEN AUTHOR_CM.MEMBER_STATUS = 'KICKED' THEN '강퇴된 회원' WHEN M.MEMBER_STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN '탈퇴한 회원' ELSE COALESCE(M.NICKNAME, '알 수 없는 회원') END AS writerNickname, CASE WHEN AUTHOR_CM.MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.MEMBER_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND M.MEMBER_STATUS <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND AUTHOR_CM.CLUB_ROLE IN ('LEADER', 'MANAGER') THEN AUTHOR_CM.CLUB_ROLE ELSE NULL END AS writerRole, P.NOTICE_YN AS pinnedYn, P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, P.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, NULL AS displayNumber FROM HM_CLUB_POST P LEFT JOIN HM_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.AUTHOR_MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN HM_CLUB_MEMBER AUTHOR_CM ON AUTHOR_CM.CLUB_ID = P.CLUB_ID AND AUTHOR_CM.MEMBER_ID = P.AUTHOR_MEMBER_ID
ORDER BY P.NOTICE_YN DESC, P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.CLUB_POST_ID DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT P.CLUB_POST_ID AS postId, P.CLUB_ID AS clubId, P.AUTHOR_MEMBER_ID AS writerMemberId, P.TITLE AS title, P.CONTENT AS content, CASE WHEN AUTHOR_CM.MEMBER_STATUS = 'LEFT' THEN '탈퇴한 회원' WHEN AUTHOR_CM.MEMBER_STATUS = 'KICKED' THEN '강퇴된 회원' WHEN M.MEMBER_STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN '탈퇴한 회원' ELSE COALESCE(M.NICKNAME, '알 수 없는 회원') END AS writerNickname, CASE WHEN AUTHOR_CM.MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.MEMBER_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND M.MEMBER_STATUS <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND AUTHOR_CM.CLUB_ROLE IN ('LEADER', 'MANAGER') THEN AUTHOR_CM.CLUB_ROLE ELSE NULL END AS writerRole, P.NOTICE_YN AS pinnedYn, P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, P.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM HM_CLUB_POST P LEFT JOIN HM_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.AUTHOR_MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN HM_CLUB_MEMBER AUTHOR_CM ON AUTHOR_CM.CLUB_ID = P.CLUB_ID AND AUTHOR_CM.MEMBER_ID = P.AUTHOR_MEMBER_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE HM_CLUB_POST P SET VIEW_COUNT = P.VIEW_COUNT + 1, UPDATED_AT = P.UPDATED_AT
mapper.sql: P.CLUB_ID = #{clubId} AND P.POST_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND P.POST_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT P.CLUB_POST_ID AS postId, P.TITLE AS title, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM HM_CLUB_POST P WHERE AND ( P.CREATED_AT < #{createdAt} OR (P.CREATED_AT = #{createdAt} AND P.CLUB_POST_ID < #{postId}) ) ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.CLUB_POST_ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT P.CLUB_POST_ID AS postId, P.TITLE AS title, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM HM_CLUB_POST P WHERE AND ( P.CREATED_AT > #{createdAt} OR (P.CREATED_AT = #{createdAt} AND P.CLUB_POST_ID > #{postId}) ) ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT ASC, P.CLUB_POST_ID ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HM_CLUB_POST P WHERE P.CLUB_ID = #{clubId} AND P.POST_TYPE = #{postType} AND P.NOTICE_YN = 'Y' AND P.POST_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HM_CLUB_POST ( CLUB_ID, AUTHOR_MEMBER_ID, MEETING_ID, POST_TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, VIEW_COUNT, NOTICE_YN, POST_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DELETED_AT ) VALUES ( #{clubId}, #{authorMemberId}, NULL, #{postType}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, #{pinnedYn}, 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL )
